column1: # kw-g2bc: group 2 boundary-condition keywords (EC*, WIN*, nodal BCC*/CRBFLX/RHTFLX/HDNOBJ, BCCFNC, LOC*, RSEDEF).
# Shell functions (parser 0x14038b8a0, object writer 0x14029e250) are kw-g2obj's; this packet ports their cases
# 0x1402a4a80 (kw-g2sv's state-variable writer): its cases 0x41..0x4c (the EC arrays) are ported inside ec.cpp because
#   1402abf20 needs them; kw-g2sv should export or call g2bc::write_keyword for those codes.
# Not ported here: 0x14026a3c0 (_OBJ_GEO3D getter, p1-07; WIN shape 3 stops at DEF_NOT_PORTED),
#   0x1401fc290 (ELMCON boundary build, mesh packet; should call bc::recount_boundary_segments and
#   bc::realloc_edge_face_arrays), 0x140235c10 (p1-12; set_node_count stops there until it lands).
# Test-only stand-ins (in tests only): RZ/ELMCON counts and boundary build, model component widths.
# Known divergence (not reproducible, not matched): GEOTYP read after RZ in 2D changes the BCCDEF/BCCDFN
#   width (model+0x1640/0x1644 via FUN_1401d0fc0 -> 1401d09c0) while 140199650 only reallocs the per-node
#   int arrays (realloc, no re-layout), so the original writes heap garbage in BCCDEF/BCCDFN. The port does
#   the same width update and realloc (call_1401d0fc0); the newly grown bytes differ (heap contents).
